name: add-tab
description: Adds a new tab (sheet) to a Google Sheets spreadsheet, optionally with a header row. The spreadsheet can be a URL copied from the browser or an id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets. Answers the new tab's sheetId and title.

spreadsheet.description: The spreadsheet URL copied from the browser, or its id from google-sheets__find-spreadsheets.

title.description: The name of the new tab.

header.description: Optional header row to write into the new tab.
